newsitem.title: USA: American Energy Group gets funding.
newsitem.headline: American Energy Group gets funding.

text.p: American Energy Group Ltd said Friday Bonus-Trade AG has funded the first $2.6 million of its total commitment of $5.0 million into the company's projects in the United States and Pakistan.

The company also said its Hycarbex-American Energy Inc subsidiary and Hunt Exploration and Mining Co CV have agreed at the company's request to terminate their joint venture for development of the Jacobabad, Pakistan, concession.
Hycarbex said it has acquired 256 kilometers of seismic data on the Pakistan concession, completing the second year requirements of the exploration license.
Once the data is processed and interpreted, the company said, it intends to proceed with development per the terms of the exploration license.
